entities.name: L4 radiculopathy localization
observations: Reduced patellar reflex and medial lower-leg sensory symptoms favor L4 radiculopathy; radiation pattern and straight-leg raise are not uniquely localizing.

entities.name: L3-L4 disc level
observations: An L3-L4 disc lesion commonly compresses the traversing L4 root, making it the best-matching offered lesion level.
